mapper.select: SELECT banner_title, banner_description, banner_image_url, button_link_type, button_link_target, section_order FROM cms_site_main_page_settings WHERE singleton_id = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cms_site_main_page_settings ( singleton_id, banner_title, banner_description, banner_image_url, button_link_type, button_link_target, section_order ) VALUES ( 1, #{bannerTitle}, #{bannerDescription}, #{bannerImageUrl}, #{buttonLinkType}, #{buttonLinkTarget}, #{sectionOrder} ) ON CONFLICT (singleton_id) DO UPDATE SET banner_title = EXCLUDED.banner_title, banner_description = EXCLUDED.banner_description, banner_image_url = EXCLUDED.banner_image_url, button_link_type = EXCLUDED.button_link_type, button_link_target = EXCLUDED.button_link_target, section_order = EXCLUDED.section_order, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
